experience.title: Talent Support Advisor
experience.subtitle: Customer Discovery & Funnel Qualification · ASM Sports (Sports Talent Management & Consulting), Remote
experience.context: ASM Sports sells an annual membership (~$2,500/yr) that lets professionals operate as independent sports agents. As one of five to six advisors on the Agent Advisory team, I was the first point of contact for applicants, qualified them, and handed sales-ready leads to senior closing agents.
bullets: Synthesized feedback from hundreds of customer conversations into a buyer profile (coaches and sports-business owners seeking flexible, supplemental income) and formalized it into four segmentation and qualification criteria: sales background, sports experience, entrepreneurial drive and business acumen.

Performed root cause analysis on recurring objections (cost, commission-based compensation, household approval), traced them to expectations set before the first conversation, addressed program terms earlier in calls, and recommended clearer upfront communication.
Managed an 800+ applicant inbound funnel from LinkedIn and Indeed over a five-month campaign using a structured five-step call, text and email sequence, achieving a 31% first-attempt connect rate.
Conducted 380+ final-stage qualification interviews and converted 350+ applicants (43% of the funnel) into sales-ready leads for seven senior closing agents.
Added qualification fields to the team's lead tracker and used AI-generated meeting summaries (Granola) to brief closing agents on each lead's background, needs and objections before handoff.

experience.title: Digital Operations & Business Strategy Analyst
experience.subtitle: Product Launch & Go-to-Market · PhiloSoccer Academy, Washington DC Area
experience.context: A private soccer-training academy offering private sessions, group training and summer camps in partnership with Nike. I owned the academy's digital go-to-market end to end, working directly with the founder and an external videographer.
bullets: Defined the scope for and rebuilt the foundation in the first month: a new visual identity, a redesigned Squarespace website and booking form, Canva templates, and a content calendar in Metricool.

Relaunched the academy's inactive Instagram and Facebook channels in October 2025; daily Instagram views rose from near zero to 5,000–8,000 within two weeks, reaching 333K views and 29% follower growth (to ~8,000) by January 2026.

Built a biweekly KPI report for the founder ranking posts and content formats by reach and engagement, used to prioritize what to repeat and what to retire — iterating toward short tactical-coaching Reels doubled Reels interactions (+104%) and increased saves by 234%.

Recommended top-performing content for owner-approved paid promotion targeted to the DC–Maryland–Virginia area, reaching 83K people, and ran search-intent research and competitive benchmarking of nearby academies to restructure website content.
Launched a 15+ email campaign for the Summer 2026 PhiloSoccer × Nike camps; Instagram generated most of the ~15 new family inquiries received during this period.
